newsitem.title: USA: Players co-founder retires, Merv Griffin joins board.
newsitem.headline: Players co-founder retires, Merv Griffin joins board.

text.p: Players International Inc. said Monday its vice chairman and co-founder, David Fishman, will retire and industry executive and former talk show host Merv Griffin has joined its board of directors.

The casino and gaming company said Griffin, whose Griffin Group Inc. and affiliates hold about 17 percent of Players, is one of four outside directors it has added to its board, bringing the total number of directors to 10.
Players also named John Groom chief operating officer. Groom has been the company's executive vice president of operations since March of this year.
Co-founder Edward Fishman will continue as chairman of the board but will no longer have operating responsibilities, Players said.
In August, Griffin agreed to sell Griffin Gaming and Entertainment Inc., which owns the Resorts hotel in Atlantic City, to Sun International for $210 million.
Players stock gained $1.125 to $7.625 on heavy volume of 1.3 million shares on Nasdaq.
